notes.title: Complete Game Rebuild
notes.content: XOMBEE has been complete rebuilt using Unreal Engine 5.1 , Better Graphics and Better Optimization , Audio and Graphic Settings have been reworked and can be Controlled from the Menu . Please Read the Game Description in STEAM Store for a complete overview of additional features added . All Player Suggestions and/or Complaints have been addressed , I appreciate the input and hopefully a better more enjoyable game is the result ..... I am working on adding achievements and a Leader Board for scoring in next Update .....  Thanks for playing !!!
